snippet.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER] BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW, FOLLOW, DARK DAWN
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW is a first-person psychological horror that delves into the impact of social media on mental health. Step into the story of Anne, a bullying victim trapped in a surreal nightmare, where she must unravel a dark mystery and confront sinister creatures.
